name: api-design
description: Design an API by selecting style (REST / GraphQL / gRPC / WebSocket / SSE / tRPC) and applying per-style best practices. REST: resource modeling + URI design + verbs + status codes + HATEOAS awareness + pagination + filtering + sorting. GraphQL: schema-first + resolvers + query complexity + N+1 avoidance via dataloaders + persisted queries. gRPC: proto contracts + streaming modes + deadline propagation. Produces style recommendation with trade-offs, endpoint/schema design, error taxonomy, pagination + filtering strategy, versioning handoff. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
